tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search the Jobmesh index of open job postings, aggregated from many public ATS and job boards worldwide. Filter by role/skill keyword, free-text location, ISO-2 country code, seniority level, category, or remote-only. Returns matching openings, each with a link back to its original source.

tools.name: index_stats
tools.description: Headline numbers about the Jobmesh index: open postings, companies and source platforms.

tools.name: source_coverage
tools.description: Transparency: the source platforms Jobmesh indexes, with how many open roles and company boards each carries and whether its last refresh succeeded. Every number traces back to a real fetch of public data.
